_meta.notes: Phase-3 basic seasonal weather lookup. Compiled from Wikipedia climate tables, Open-Meteo historical norms, and regional meteorological summaries. Used by WeatherAgent when the travel month is outside Open-Meteo's 16-day forecast horizon.
_meta.source: Wikipedia / Open-Meteo historical / regional meteorological summaries

hunza-karimabad.notes: Cold winters, pleasant summers. Monsoon influence is weaker than the southern mountains.

skardu.notes: High-altitude desert climate. Very dry; most precipitation in spring.

naran.notes: Strong monsoon influence Jul-Aug. Babusar Pass closes Nov-May.

fairy-meadows.notes: Alpine meadow at 3,300m. Accessible only Jun-Oct. Cold even in summer nights.

murree.notes: Wettest in Jul-Aug monsoon. Snowfall Dec-Feb. Year-round accessible.

gilgit.notes: Warmest lowland in GB. Dry; excellent acclimatization stop before higher altitudes.

passu.notes: North of Hunza; slightly colder and drier than Karimabad. Khunjerab season Apr-Nov.

attabad.notes: Lakeside microclimate. Lake-effect cold even in summer evenings.

khaplu.notes: Eastern Gilgit-Baltistan. Similar to Skardu but slightly wetter.

swat-kalam.notes: Monsoon-heavy Jul-Aug. Dense forest keeps humidity high. Accessible Apr-Nov.

shogran.notes: Similar to Naran but slightly milder. Monsoon Jul-Aug. Jeep track from Kiwai.

neelum.notes: Kashmir valley climate. Monsoon Jul-Aug. NOC required for foreign travellers.

deosai.notes: Highest plateau (4,114m). Brief summer season mid-Jun to mid-Sep. Freezing year-round nights.

chitral.notes: Western Hindu Kush. Hot dry summers. Kalash valleys cooler. Lowari Tunnel year-round.
